scripts.lint: oxlint --quiet --format=unix --ignore-pattern node_modules . && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --pretty false && mkdir -p dist/native && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && cp native/target/release/libtssae_test_adapter.so dist/native/libtssae_test_adapter.so && cp native/tssae-native.json dist/tssae-native.json && cargo build --locked --release --features wrong-abi --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && cp native/target/release/libtssae_test_adapter.so native/target/release/libtssae_bad_abi.so
